supplements.title: 18-β-glycyrrhetinic acid facilitates nuclear-mitochondrial communications to alleviate oxidative stress through HMGB1-cGAS-Mul1 axis in tendinopathy.
supplements.summary: A natural compound called 18-β-glycyrrhetinic acid reduces tendon damage by decreasing harmful stress inside cells through a specific molecular pathway.

supplements.title: Fructose: metabolic signal and modern hazard.
supplements.summary: Fructose uniquely promotes fat accumulation and metabolic disease more than glucose, with emerging links to cancer and dementia.

supplements.title: Chasteberry extract alleviates rotenone-triggered testicular injury in rats by modulating oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis, and mitochondrial dysfunction.
supplements.summary: Chasteberry extract protects rat testes from pesticide damage by reducing oxidative stress, inflammation, and cell death.

supplements.title: Curcumin-Integrated Smart Nanocarriers: A Multi-Stimuli-Responsive Platform for Targeted Delivery of 5-Fluorouracil in Cancer Therapy.
supplements.summary: Smart nanocarriers enhanced curcumin and 5-fluorouracil delivery to cancer cells, improving drug effectiveness in breast and liver cancer models.

supplements.title: Effect of Probiotics on the Clinical Outcome and Inflammatory Response in Gastric Cancer Surgery: A Double Blinded Randomized Control Trial.
supplements.summary: Probiotics given to gastric cancer surgery patients reduced inflammation and improved recovery outcomes by restoring healthy gut bacteria.

supplements.title: Exploring the mechanisms of Cangfu Daotan decoction in homotherapy for heteropathy of polycystic ovary syndrome, insulin resistance, infertility, and obesity.
supplements.summary: A traditional Chinese herbal formula may treat polycystic ovary syndrome, insulin resistance, obesity, and infertility through four key plant compounds.

supplements.title: Exploring the mechanisms of luteolin in treating polycystic ovary syndrome and endometriosis via network pharmacology, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulation.
supplements.summary: Luteolin, a plant compound, may effectively treat polycystic ovary syndrome and endometriosis by targeting multiple genes and pathways simultaneously.

supplements.title: JI-CJ002 and Dabrafenib Combination Enhances Antitumor Activity in Melanoma Associated With the Downregulation of B7-H3.
supplements.summary: Combining an herbal extract with melanoma drug dabrafenib enhances tumor shrinkage by reducing a protein called B7-H3.

supplements.title: Temporally Programmed and Laser-Triggered Immunomodulatory Hydrogel Enables Synergistic Wound Healing and Prevention of Postoperative Tumor Recurrence.
supplements.summary: A specialized hydrogel implanted at colorectal cancer surgery sites prevents complications, heals wounds, and kills remaining tumors when triggered by laser light.

supplements.title: Multi-omics reveals gut microbiome- and metabolome-specific responses to sugar alcohols.
supplements.summary: Different sugar alcohols uniquely alter gut bacteria and metabolites, with isomalt showing the greatest health benefits in rats.

supplements.title: Iturin derived from Bacillus modulates lipid and glucose metabolism while mitigating the progression of MASLD.
supplements.summary: A bacterial compound called iturin reduces liver fat and improves metabolism in mice fed high-fat diets, suggesting potential for treating liver disease.

supplements.title: Targeting the ROS-JNK/p38 Axis: Schisandrin A as a Novel Therapeutic Candidate for Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Schisandrin A kills esophageal cancer cells by triggering a specific cellular pathway that causes apoptosis and stops cell growth.

supplements.title: Two Triterpenoids with a Cyclobutane Moiety from Mastic: Structural Elucidation and Biological Evaluation.
supplements.summary: A novel mastic compound inhibited colorectal cancer cell growth with promising potency and anti-inflammatory effects.

supplements.title: Selective TRPV2 Antagonists Derived from the Natural Product Piperlongumine Inhibit Cancer Cell Migration and Metastasis.
supplements.summary: Researchers developed selective TRPV2-blocking drugs from a natural product that inhibit cancer cell migration and metastasis.

supplements.title: Organoid phenotypic screening identified glycyrrhizin that confers protection against tumor necrosis factor-induced cell death.
supplements.summary: Glycyrrhizin, derived from licorice root, protects intestinal cells from TNF-induced death, offering potential treatment for Crohn's disease.

off_label.title: Nicotinamide N-methyltransferase as a therapeutic target in taxane-resistant castration-resistant prostate cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking NNMT protein reversed taxane resistance in prostate cancer by suppressing TGFβ signaling and epithelial-mesenchymal transition pathways.

off_label.title: mTOR-driven integrin β4-enriched extracellular vesicles from lenvatinib-resistant hepatocellular carcinoma fuel lung metastasis via fibroblast-niche formation.
off_label.summary: Drug-resistant liver cancer cells release particles enriched with integrin β4 that promote lung metastasis and can be blocked with existing drugs.

off_label.title: Clinical Study to Evaluate the Possible Safety and Efficacy of Dapagliflozin in the Prophylaxis of Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity in Breast Cancer Patients
off_label.summary: Dapagliflozin may protect breast cancer patients' hearts from damage caused by doxorubicin chemotherapy.

off_label.title: Circadian disruption exacerbates MASH by reducing Akkermansia muciniphila via the FXR-CYP7A1-bile acid axis.
off_label.summary: Circadian disruption worsens liver disease by reducing beneficial gut bacteria through disrupted bile acid metabolism, reversible with bacterial or drug treatments.

off_label.title: Association between inhaled corticosteroids and anti-PD-1/PD-L1 efficacy in patients with NSCLC with concurrent COPD.
off_label.summary: Inhaled corticosteroids for COPD improve lung cancer immunotherapy response in patients with both conditions.

off_label.title: ACLY-Driven Metabolic Reprogramming Promotes Histone Acetylation and Inflammation-Associated Fibrosis in Chronic Kidney Disease.
off_label.summary: ACLY enzyme drives kidney fibrosis by increasing histone acetylation and inflammation; blocking it reduces fibrosis in chronic kidney disease.

off_label.title: Efgartigimod as Rescue Therapy for PD-1 Inhibitor-Associated Myasthenia Gravis, Myocarditis, and Myositis (MMM) Syndrome: A 2-Case Report and Literature Review.
off_label.summary: Efgartigimod shows promise as a rescue treatment for severe immune-related muscle and heart complications caused by cancer immunotherapy drugs.

off_label.title: CRITICAL ROLE OF DYSREGULATED AUTOPHAGY IN PATHOPHYSIOLOGY OF PODOCYTOPATHY.
off_label.summary: Restoring autophagy in kidney cells shows promise for treating podocytopathies by reducing protein loss and improving cell function.

off_label.title: Perindopril and L‑arginine protect against arsenic trioxide-induced neurotoxicity via Keap1/Nrf2/HO‑1 activation and suppression of neuroinflammation and apoptosis.
off_label.summary: Perindopril and L-arginine together protect against arsenic trioxide's nerve damage in leukemia treatment by reducing inflammation and cell death.

off_label.title: PBK-Loaded secretory autophagosomes drive radiotherapy-induced systemic adipose depletion via MAPK/ERK-PRKA/PKA-LIPE/HSL signaling: a therapeutic target for esophageal cancer cachexia.
off_label.summary: Radiotherapy for esophageal cancer causes harmful fat loss through secreted particles containing PBK; blocking PBK with OTS-514 restores fat and improves treatment.

off_label.title: Altered Sphingolipid Metabolism is Associated with Osimertinib Resistance in Nonsmall-Cell Lung Cancer.
off_label.summary: Lung cancer cells resist osimertinib by altering fat metabolism; combining the drug with a metabolism inhibitor restores treatment sensitivity.

off_label.title: Exenatide attenuates neuroinflammation and rescues sepsis-induced depressive behavior and cognitive dysfunction in a mouse model.
off_label.summary: Exenatide, a diabetes drug, reduces brain inflammation and improves depression and memory problems caused by sepsis in mice.

off_label.title: NF-κB signaling drives rapid skeletal muscle atrophy in patients with breast cancer: The cost of fighting cancer with chemotherapy.
off_label.summary: NF-κB signaling drives chemotherapy-induced muscle wasting in breast cancer patients; sulfasalazine may prevent it.

off_label.title: Ovarian radiation injury and protection: Mechanisms, delivery-enabled interventions, and future directions.
off_label.summary: New drug delivery systems may protect ovaries from radiation damage during cancer treatment while preserving fertility in young women.

off_label.title: Targeting mitochondria in triple-negative breast cancer: Emerging therapeutic and drug development strategies.
off_label.summary: Targeting mitochondria shows promise as a new treatment strategy for triple-negative breast cancer by disrupting cancer cell metabolism and survival.

biomarkers.title: MnUA-DOX-artesunate hydrogel remodels immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and prevents postoperative recurrence in triple-negative breast cancer.
biomarkers.summary: A new injectable gel combining three drugs boosts immune response and prevents triple-negative breast cancer recurrence after surgery.

biomarkers.title: [Research progress in clinical pathology and molecular mechanisms of pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma].
biomarkers.summary: Pancreatic adenosquamous carcinoma, a rare aggressive cancer, may benefit from immunotherapy targeting PD-L1 expression and checkpoint pathways.

biomarkers.title: [Conversion therapy for hepatoid adenocarcinoma of the stomach: A case report].
biomarkers.summary: A HER2-targeted antibody-drug conjugate combined with immunotherapy and anti-angiogenic therapy successfully shrank chemotherapy-resistant stomach cancer, enabling surgery and long-term remission.

biomarkers.title: 18-β-glycyrrhetinic acid facilitates nuclear-mitochondrial communications to alleviate oxidative stress through HMGB1-cGAS-Mul1 axis in tendinopathy.
biomarkers.summary: A natural compound called 18-β-glycyrrhetinic acid reduces tendon damage by decreasing harmful stress inside cells through a specific molecular pathway.

biomarkers.title: Viral variant but not host factors associate with SARS-CoV-2 viral kinetics.
biomarkers.summary: SARS-CoV-2 viral variants, not patient characteristics, determine how quickly the virus replicates in infected individuals.

biomarkers.title: PRMT5 inhibition sensitizes B-cell lymphoma cells to ferroptosis.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking PRMT5 protein makes B-cell lymphoma cells vulnerable to ferroptosis, a cell death process, especially when combined with another drug.

biomarkers.title: Programmed cell death in lung cancer: mechanisms, immune responses, and therapeutics.
biomarkers.summary: Targeting programmed cell death pathways alongside immunotherapy may help overcome immune resistance in lung cancer by activating anti-tumor immune responses.

biomarkers.title: SLC33A1 exports oxidized glutathione to maintain endoplasmic reticulum redox homeostasis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered that SLC33A1 protein exports oxidized glutathione from cells' protein-making compartments, maintaining proper conditions for protein development.

biomarkers.title: Fructose: metabolic signal and modern hazard.
biomarkers.summary: Fructose uniquely promotes fat accumulation and metabolic disease more than glucose, with emerging links to cancer and dementia.

biomarkers.title: Antitumor immunotoxin expression is enhanced by Escherichia coli csrB-promoter activity.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers enhanced cancer-fighting bacteria by using a natural tumor sensor to activate anticancer proteins only within tumors, improving treatment effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: FAAH initiates a positive feedback loop to promote lung adenocarcinoma progression through inhibition of ferroptosis.
biomarkers.summary: FAAH protein promotes lung adenocarcinoma growth by blocking a natural cancer cell death process, creating a cycle that could be targeted therapeutically.

biomarkers.title: Chasteberry extract alleviates rotenone-triggered testicular injury in rats by modulating oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis, and mitochondrial dysfunction.
biomarkers.summary: Chasteberry extract protects rat testes from pesticide damage by reducing oxidative stress, inflammation, and cell death.

biomarkers.title: Mechanisms of autophagy-mediated ferroptosis regulation in intestinal mucosal injury under high-G environments.
biomarkers.summary: High-G exposure damages the intestine through ferroptosis; blocking autophagy protects against this injury in rats.

biomarkers.title: Nicotinamide N-methyltransferase as a therapeutic target in taxane-resistant castration-resistant prostate cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking NNMT protein reversed taxane resistance in prostate cancer by suppressing TGFβ signaling and epithelial-mesenchymal transition pathways.

biomarkers.title: Core Components of the Hippo Pathway.
biomarkers.summary: The Hippo pathway controls cell growth and tumor suppression through a kinase cascade that regulates YAP/TAZ proteins and gene expression.

trials.title: Long-Term Outcomes, Moderators, and Predictors in Online Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy for People With Cancer: Secondary Analysis of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
trials.summary: Online mindfulness-based cognitive therapy reduced psychological distress in cancer patients and survivors, with benefits lasting at least three months.

trials.summary: ADCE-T02, a new antibody drug targeting tissue factor, shows superior tumor killing with fewer side effects than existing treatments across multiple cancer types.

trials.summary: Researchers created new indole-based compounds that showed strong anticancer activity against lung and bladder cancer cells with minimal toxicity to healthy cells.

trials.title: Effect of Probiotics on the Clinical Outcome and Inflammatory Response in Gastric Cancer Surgery: A Double Blinded Randomized Control Trial.

trials.title: Metabolomics profiling of acute myelogenous leukemia patients to identify systemic differences associated with in vitro sensitivity to SYK inhibitors.
trials.summary: Researchers identified metabolic differences in AML patients that predict which tumors respond to SYK inhibitor drugs.

trials.title: Ivosidenib and Vorasidenib decrease intratumoral 2-hydroxyglutarate and total choline levels in patients with lower-grade glioma: an in vivo MR Spectroscopy study.
trials.summary: Two drugs successfully reduced a harmful chemical in slow-growing brain tumors, offering a non-invasive way to monitor treatment response.

trials.title: Protein Kinase D1 Translocates PARP1 to the Membrane and Is Associated With Increased Sensitivity to Cell Viability Inhibition by PARP1 Inhibitor Olaparib.
trials.summary: Protein Kinase D1 increases prostate cancer cell sensitivity to PARP inhibitor treatment, potentially allowing lower, safer doses.

mind_body.summary: Online mindfulness-based cognitive therapy reduced psychological distress in cancer patients and survivors, with benefits lasting at least three months.

mind_body.title: One Herd: A Community Storytelling Campaign for Equity in Adolescent and Young Adult Cancer Survivorship.
mind_body.summary: A storytelling campaign called One Herd elevates the voices and experiences of underserved adolescent and young adult cancer survivors from underrepresented communities.

mind_body.title: The Experience and Management of Cancer Screening-Related Anxiety in Fanconi Anemia: an Ethnographic Study
mind_body.summary: Study examines anxiety experienced by Fanconi anemia patients during frequent cancer screening visits through observational research methods.

mind_body.title: CBPR Intervention to Decrease Lung Cancer Stigma and Health Disparities (LUNGevity Lung Cancer Stigma Reduction)
mind_body.summary: Researchers tested a virtual mindfulness intervention to reduce lung cancer stigma and health disparities in underserved communities.

mind_body.title: Phase II Randomized Controlled Trial of C-SMART Versus BE Well for Patients With Brain Tumors on Neurocognitive and Neuroimaging Outcomes
mind_body.summary: Brain tumor patients tested two interventions—cognitive rehabilitation with mindfulness versus educational videos—to improve thinking skills and brain health.

mind_body.title: Coping with primary brain tumors together: a scoping review of dyadic psychosocial interventions.
mind_body.summary: Couples-based counseling interventions help glioma patients and caregivers better cope with the disease's emotional and practical challenges.

mind_body.title: [Warming acupuncture combined with Duhuo Jisheng decoction for lumbar disc herniation of qi stagnation and blood stasis accompanied with liver-kidney deficiency: a randomized controlled trial].
mind_body.summary: To compare the therapeutic effect between warming acupuncture combined with Duhuo Jisheng decoction and Duhuo Jisheng decoction alone in the treatment of lumbar disc herniation (LDH) of qi stagnati...

mind_body.title: [Effects of electroacupuncture on gastrointestinal dysfunction and serum metabolites in postoperative patients with gastric cancer].
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture helps gastric cancer patients recover digestive function faster after surgery by improving gut movement.

mind_body.title: Effects of Preoperative Mindfulness Training Combined With Active Breathing and Circulation Exercises on Pulmonary Function Recovery in Lung Cancer Patients After Lobectomy.
mind_body.summary: Preoperative mindfulness training with breathing exercises improved lung function recovery in lung cancer patients after surgery.

mind_body.title: Chronic psychological stress disrupts liver homeostasis by dysregulating oxidative phosphorylation via the PI3K/AKT/FoxO3a axis.
mind_body.summary: Chronic psychological stress damages the liver by suppressing a cellular energy pathway through the PI3K/AKT/FoxO3a signaling axis.

mind_body.title: Mental adjustment to cancer and its predictors in patients with non-small cell lung cancer undergoing surgery.
mind_body.summary: Study identifies factors predicting how lung cancer surgery patients mentally adjust to their cancer diagnosis.

mind_body.title: Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial Comparing Brief Behavioral Therapy for Cancer Related Insomnia (BBT-CI) and Healthy Eating Education Learning (HEAL)
mind_body.summary: A new study tests whether brief behavioral therapy helps cancer patients sleep better than a healthy eating education program.

mind_body.title: A Feasibility Trial Comparing the Effectiveness of Virtual YOCAS©® Yoga to Standard Care for Treating Insomnia in Cancer Survivors
mind_body.summary: Virtual yoga significantly improves insomnia and sleep quality in cancer survivors compared to standard care.

mind_body.title: Controlled Trial Of Acupuncture To Prevent Radiation-Induced Xerostomia
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture may prevent dry mouth in head and neck cancer patients undergoing radiation therapy.

mind_body.title: Social Media Use in Advanced Cancer: Patient Considerations of Social Media Account Management After Death
mind_body.summary: Advanced cancer patients discuss how family should manage their social media accounts after death, addressing digital legacy concerns.
